notes.title: Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35075316/0be69842fd692816e1cd1ed367de172bf20875b5.jpg

* New item - Nova. It causes a explosion that hit nearby enemies.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35075316/5158a909c3b86f0fdac1c8c7cddf08c11c91a523.jpg

* New game mode - Surrounded.
It's a simple but hard mode, based on classic enemy waves.

notes.title: News!!
notes.content:

notes.title: Help from above...
notes.content:

Upgrades:

 Better flamethrower animation.
 Options to show player damage info and enemy damage info.
 Supply Plane for every 15 rooms. Drop 25% health item.
 Now, options menu can be acessed in game.

Thanks to the user 'Sweetly Sick', he helped me a lot by informing some problems.

notes.title: More bug fixes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35075316/14bfa17075d3f45a6f2fc306b5fa53b9abb23edc.png


 Now the bomb tanks have a minimum distance that can be spawn close to the player.
 Fixed problem of 3D audio directions.

notes.title: Some bug fixing, some upgrades....
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35075316/ecdda128e7e0489cbee3e7b8a9caff6aaaca43a6.png

Fixed in this new version:

 Homing Missile - If the target has died, try to find another target instead of aimlessly.
Spread Gun - Very loud sound when firing removed
Auto Turret - Strange rotation when the target is below ground - fixed.


Upgrades
Better behavior of the kamikaze item. Now it generates colorful mini-planes that give its own life to protect you
